mapper.select: SELECT id, name, active FROM public.department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND active

SELECT day.id AS attendance_day_id, day.attendance_date, day.status, policy.name AS policy_name, count(target.member_id) FILTER (WHERE target.is_target) AS target_count, count(record.id) FILTER (WHERE record.status = 'PRESENT') AS present_count, count(record.id) FILTER (WHERE record.status = 'LATE') AS late_count, count(record.id) FILTER (WHERE record.status = 'ABSENT') AS absent_count FROM public.attendance_day AS day JOIN public.attendance_policy_version AS policy ON policy.id = day.policy_version_id AND policy.department_id = day.department_id LEFT JOIN public.attendance_target AS target ON target.attendance_day_id = day.id AND target.department_id = day.department_id LEFT JOIN public.attendance_record AS record ON record.attendance_day_id = day.id AND record.member_id = target.member_id WHERE day.department_id = #{departmentId} AND day.attendance_date = #{today} GROUP BY day.id, policy.name

SELECT member.id, member.name, member.phone, member.birth, COALESCE( extract(year FROM age(#{today}, member.birth))::integer, member.age ) AS display_age, membership.joined_at, card.id AS card_id, card.status AS card_status, CASE WHEN card.uid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE '****' || right(card.uid, 4) END AS masked_uid FROM public.department_membership AS membership JOIN public.member AS member ON member.id = membership.member_id LEFT JOIN public.nfc_card_assignment AS assignment ON assignment.department_id = membership.department_id AND assignment.membership_id = membership.id AND assignment.member_id = membership.member_id AND assignment.unassigned_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN public.nfc_card AS card ON card.id = assignment.nfc_card_id WHERE membership.department_id = #{departmentId} AND membership.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY lower(member.name), member.id

SELECT member.id, member.name, member.phone, member.birth, COALESCE( extract(year FROM age(#{today}, member.birth))::integer, member.age ) AS display_age, member.created_at, membership.joined_at, card.id AS card_id, card.status AS card_status, CASE WHEN card.uid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE '****' || right(card.uid, 4) END AS masked_uid FROM public.department_membership AS membership JOIN public.member AS member ON member.id = membership.member_id LEFT JOIN public.nfc_card_assignment AS assignment ON assignment.department_id = membership.department_id AND assignment.membership_id = membership.id AND assignment.member_id = membership.member_id AND assignment.unassigned_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN public.nfc_card AS card ON card.id = assignment.nfc_card_id WHERE membership.department_id = #{departmentId} AND membership.member_id = #{memberId} AND membership.ended_at IS NULL

SELECT day.id AS attendance_day_id, day.attendance_date, day.status AS day_status, target.is_target, record.status, record.band_label_snapshot, record.checked_in_at, record.note FROM public.attendance_target AS target JOIN public.attendance_day AS day ON day.id = target.attendance_day_id AND day.department_id = target.department_id LEFT JOIN public.attendance_record AS record ON record.attendance_day_id = target.attendance_day_id AND record.member_id = target.member_id WHERE target.department_id = #{departmentId} AND target.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY day.attendance_date DESC, day.id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT id, version_no, name, check_in_start_time, status, created_at, published_at FROM public.attendance_policy_version WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT band.sequence_no, band.label, band.parent_status, band.upper_time FROM public.attendance_band AS band JOIN public.attendance_policy_version AS policy ON policy.id = band.policy_version_id WHERE policy.department_id = #{departmentId} AND policy.id = #{policyId} ORDER BY band.sequence_no
SELECT id, version_no, name, check_in_start_time FROM public.attendance_policy_version WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT day.id, day.attendance_date, day.status, policy.name AS policy_name, policy.version_no AS policy_version_no, count(target.member_id) FILTER (WHERE target.is_target) AS target_count, count(record.id) AS record_count FROM public.attendance_day AS day JOIN public.attendance_policy_version AS policy ON policy.id = day.policy_version_id AND policy.department_id = day.department_id LEFT JOIN public.attendance_target AS target ON target.attendance_day_id = day.id AND target.department_id = day.department_id LEFT JOIN public.attendance_record AS record ON record.attendance_day_id = day.id AND record.member_id = target.member_id WHERE day.department_id = #{departmentId} GROUP BY day.id, policy.name, policy.version_no ORDER BY day.attendance_date DESC, day.id DESC

SELECT day.id, day.attendance_date, day.status, day.policy_version_id, policy.name AS policy_name, policy.check_in_start_time FROM public.attendance_day AS day JOIN public.attendance_policy_version AS policy ON policy.id = day.policy_version_id AND policy.department_id = day.department_id WHERE day.department_id = #{departmentId} AND day.id = #{attendanceDayId}

SELECT target.member_id, member.name, target.is_target, target.added_source, record.id AS record_id, record.status, record.band_label_snapshot, record.checked_in_at, record.source, record.note FROM public.attendance_target AS target JOIN public.member AS member ON member.id = target.member_id LEFT JOIN public.attendance_record AS record ON record.attendance_day_id = target.attendance_day_id AND record.member_id = target.member_id WHERE target.department_id = #{departmentId} AND target.attendance_day_id = #{attendanceDayId} ORDER BY lower(member.name), member.id

SELECT audit.id, audit.action, audit.target_type, audit.target_id, audit.reason, audit.occurred_at, account.username AS actor_username FROM public.audit_log AS audit LEFT JOIN public.account AS account ON account.id = audit.actor_account_id WHERE audit.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY audit.occurred_at DESC, audit.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT event.id, device.name AS device_name, event.result_code, '****' || right(event.uid, 4) AS masked_uid, event.received_at FROM public.tag_event_log AS event JOIN public.device AS device ON device.id = event.device_id AND device.department_id = event.department_id WHERE event.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY event.received_at DESC, event.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT DISTINCT ON (event.uid) event.id AS event_id, '****' || right(event.uid, 4) AS masked_uid, event.result_code, device.name AS device_name, event.received_at FROM public.tag_event_log AS event JOIN public.device AS device ON device.id = event.device_id AND device.department_id = event.department_id LEFT JOIN public.nfc_card AS card ON card.uid = event.uid WHERE event.department_id = #{departmentId} AND event.result_code IN ('UNKNOWN_UID', 'INACTIVE_CARD') AND (card.id IS NULL OR card.status = 'AVAILABLE') ORDER BY event.uid, event.received_at DESC
